recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Add centered title at top: 'Calculation of Model Parameter “W”' in bold red (#C00000), with the W inside the quotes colored blue (#0000FF). 3. Top-right: draw a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with thin dark outline, place '18' inside in dark text. 4. Upper-left: draw a white rectangle with red (#C00000) border. Inside, top line: equation 'Y = X W' in large serif font — Y underlined red, X underlined blue, W underlined red. 5. Below it add 'Where:' in italic black, then three lines: 'X_{N x d+1} is a matrix' (X and subscript blue), 'Y_{Nx1} is labels vector' (Y and subscript red), 'W is Model Parameter' (W red). 6. To the right of each of the three lines place a red double arrow '⇒' followed by bold black text: 'Given', 'Given', 'Required' respectively. 7. Center-right of the left box: draw a large hollow right-pointing block arrow with light pink fill (#F2D7DC) and red outline. 8. Right side: draw a second white rectangle with red border containing 'W = X^{-1} Y' — W underlined black, X^{-1} blue with superscript -1, Y underlined red — and place a yellow smiley face emoji to the right of the equation inside the box. 9. Leave the bottom two-thirds of the slide empty.
